title: Conditional operator role, KMS/HSM failover, and SSO attribute clarity - PRD addendum + acceptance checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
requirements_summary: Addendum to the Private Deploy PRD clarifying: (1) attribute-driven SSO mappings for operator vs. readonly roles, (2) KMS/HSM key hierarchy, rotation and escrow behavior during failover, (3) audit event shape and mandated retention/immutable logs, and (4) an emergency breakglass flow that preserves auditability while granting temporary operator privileges.
scope_changes: Scope reduced from full RBAC revamp to focused: canonicalize SAML attribute names, document role equivalence mapping to our RBAC model, add KMS/HSM failover test scenarios, and add a signed-off acceptance checklist for security and SRE. Excluded: GUI role editor, cross-tenant delegation, and long-term retention expansion beyond 7 years (to be scoped in a follow-up).
detailed_requirements: 1) SSO/SAML: tolerate both 'eduPersonAffiliation' and 'redwood_role' attributes; canonical mapping table included. 2) RBAC: operator, admin, app-reader, billing roles defined with explicit allowed actions (list included in Confluence). 3) Audit logs: JSONL format, fields[ts,event,actor,actor_id,subject,action,resource,request_id,old_state,new_state,signature]. 4) KMS/HSM: root keys in HSM-backed cluster, per-tenant data encryption keys wrapped under tenant KEKs; automated rotation window 90 days with 30-day pre-rollover mirror. 5) Breakglass: one-time JWT tied to an incident runbook; issuance requires 2-of-3 approver flow and all actions recorded to an immutable audit stream.
acceptance_criteria:
- SAML attribute mapping tests pass (positive and negative cases) across Okta and ADFS connectors.
- RBAC enforcement: integration tests show operator cannot perform billing/export actions; admin can.
- Audit shape validated: a 1-hour synthetic workload produces logs that match schema and are ingested into our audit retention cluster.
- KMS failover: simulated HSM node outage results in zero data decryption errors when configured mirrors are active; key rotation completes within defined window without data loss.
- Breakglass: request->grant->action->revoke cycle recorded and timeboxed; issuance requires the configured approvers and produces signed evidence.
- Security signoff obtained from Security Eng and Legal; SRE verifies operational runbook and rollback steps.
test_plan_and_scenarios: A. SSO mapping matrix: Okta/ADFS/OneLogin test tenants, 8 user variations, verify role assignment. B. RBAC fuzz: attempt 200+ forbidden API calls as operator role; all denied with 403. C. Audit ingestion: pump synthetic events through CLI, confirm immutability by attempting to delete an event (should be denied). D. KMS/HSM failover: bring down primary HSM, measure decrypt success rates and latency. E. Breakglass dry-run during maintenance window with recorded approvals and replayable audit transcript.

open_questions_and_risks:
- Risk: customer tenants with legacy attribute names will require mapping migration; mitigation: backward-compatible mapping and a 30-day deprecation window.
- Question: Do all enterprise customers require HSM escrow? Engineering suggests per-contract opt-in to avoid regulatory export issues.
- Risk: Breakglass misuse—mitigation: 2-of-3 approver flow + automated post-incident review and penalization policy.
decisions_log:
- 2026-02-22: Chosen canonical attribute names: use 'redwood_role' primary, accept 'eduPersonAffiliation' as alias.
- 2026-02-26: KMS hierarchy decision: tenant KEK wrapping under HSM root; no local disk storage of root key material.
- 2026-03-01: Breakglass requires 2-of-3 approvers and automatically expires after 4 hours.
rollout_and_migration_notes: 1) Phase 1 (staging): enable mapping compatibility layer and run synthetic tests. 2) Phase 2 (pilot): onboard two customers with explicit consent and run a monitored 72-hour pilot. 3) Phase 3 (GA): flip default to strict canonical mapping and begin 30-day deprecation notices for legacy attributes. Migration: automated mapping table and an admin CLI to reassign roles for legacy users.
